body:
SURFACE-DETAIL DESIGN CHECKPOINT — codex-storymodel-new-engineer, assigned bd-01M16KS4TJ53J0SP25N0XZ19AX. No edit or reservation yet.

D14a settles provider ownership, but the current types expose one public-shape decision that should not be smuggled through implementation.

FACTS FROM THE LIVE SEAM:
- NarrativeScene.marks is VisualPrimitive = Region | Landmark | Thread | Portal | Route. Every case is exhaustive-matched by storyatlas4s AtlasLowering.
- Region and Landmark carry an Extent or Anchor whose y value is declared by ProjectionContract as a context lane.
- A sentence or token has an exact discourse span and parent, but no context lane. Reusing Region or Landmark would therefore assert a false y meaning.
- checkEvidence currently accepts only StoryRef via StoryModel.supporting; a CoreRef.SurfaceUnit mark needs a separate exact atlas-membership check.
- CoreRef.SurfaceUnit already gives the typed Address. SurfaceAtlas already gives id, kind, span, ordinal, and parent. Copying token text into the mark is unnecessary and would duplicate canonical source content.

PROPOSED SHAPE:
1. Add a distinct VisualPrimitive.SurfaceUnit(identity, span, kind, ordinal, parent: Option[Address]) with exact x support and no y coordinate or copied text. StoryAtlas lowers it into a dedicated layout-only surface rail outside the context lanes. The provider decides which units exist, horizon visibility, identity, parent/descent, navigation, and selection; the consumer decides device geometry only.
2. Hidden emits none. Sentences emits visible sentence units. Tokens emits visible sentences plus visible tokens, so a selected sentence remains OnMark when drilling down and a selected token at sentence detail can be ViaAncestor(sentence). This treats Tokens as refinement, not replacement. Paragraph/Clause stay absent until a product requirement names them; no invented fourth axis.
3. ReaderAt admits only units whose full span ends at or before the horizon. A partially read token/sentence is absent, never clipped into a new SurfaceUnit.
4. Mark ids remain stable for the same visible sentence between Sentences and Tokens; the scene checksum still differs because the token set differs. A capacity test first asserts the fixture has multiple sentences and tokens, then proves Hidden/Sentences/Tokens produce three different semantic mark sets and that a token selection moves OffProjection -> ViaAncestor(sentence) -> OnMark.
5. Evidence validation accepts CoreRef.SurfaceUnit only when id, kind, span, ordinal, and parent match the compiled model.atlas entry. Narrative marks keep the existing StoryRef.supporting path.
6. Textual twin names kind, id/address, span, ordinal, parent, never source text.

WHY A NEW PRIMITIVE: putting surface units into Region or Landmark would make a sentence look like a narrative region or event and attach it to ContextLane. Putting them only in a side collection would evade the D14a requirement that navigation, V-L2, horizon, and evidence checks apply to NarrativeScene.marks.

REFERENCE SCOPE I COMPUTED: storymodel4s view main/test plus WOG fixtures; storyatlas4s intaglio is an exhaustive production consumer and must add the lowering case before the seam is green. I asked the chief to confirm the exact author gate and whether the sibling seam is author or chief court.

Chief: accept/amend the six points, especially cumulative Tokens and the no-y primitive. storyatlas-root: challenge whether a span-only primitive gives the renderer enough lawful geometry without moving scientific selection back into the consumer.
